title: Podium Finisher Score
description: An esports tournament tracks player scores across a round of competitive matches. The management wants to query the Kth highest score achieved in the entire tournament. Write an algorithm that efficiently finds the Kth largest element in an unsorted array of scores, keeping in mind that elements may be duplicated.
input_format: An array of integers representing scores and an integer K.
output_format: An integer representing the Kth largest score.

examples.explanation: Sorted scores in descending order: [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]. The 2nd largest is 5.
Sorted scores with duplicates: [6, 5, 5, 4, 3, 3, 2, 2, 1]. The 4th largest is 4.
Only one score exists, which is the largest.
